stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Can it read the till's file?
stations.note: And keep the day's log whole.

stations.title: Old till
stations.text: Leaves its own file behind at closing

stations.title: Hut's records
stations.text: Notices read, log kept, till counted
stations.note: Every pound sign where it should be.

captions: The hut at Lanternquay. Bridie wants the notices, the log and the old till's file read.
Opened by hand, the till's file shows boxes where its pound signs should be.
You read files, write and add to them, and count through a long one a line at a time.
Now the till's file reads right, every pound sign in place, and the log only grows.
The hut's files keep the day between runs, and the program reads them back as written.
